$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: qc_chromatography
title: qc.chromatography.tsv
description: Charge states, chromatographic peak width and quantification counts of each searched file's confident identifications: one row per file, then a `total` row. Also written to run-summary.json under qc.chromatography.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, or `total` for the final row covering all files.

fields.name: confident_precursors
fields.description: Rank-1 target PSMs at 1% spectrum and peptide q-value. Counted as PSMs, because a charge state belongs to a PSM rather than to a peptide.

fields.name: charge_1_pct
fields.description: Percent of those precursors at charge 1, three decimals.

fields.name: charge_4_plus_pct
fields.description: Percent at charge 4 or above, three decimals.

fields.name: charge_unknown_pct
fields.description: Percent whose charge the file did not state, three decimals. The five percentages sum to 100.

fields.name: peak_width
fields.description: Chromatographic width in the file's own retention-time unit, four decimals. Which quantity it is depends on `peak_width_kind`, and the two are not interchangeable. Empty when the file had neither integrated peaks nor repeat PSMs to measure.

fields.name: peak_width_kind
fields.description: `lfq_median_fwhm`: median full width at half maximum of the file's integrated LFQ peaks, a real peak width. `repeat_psm_spread`: the median of half the distance between every pair of PSMs of one peptide in this file, the quantity the in-source check derives its co-elution tolerance from, used when no peaks were integrated. `repeat_psm_spread_fallback`: the same, for a file with too few repeats, where a fraction of the retention-time span stands in. Empty when `peak_width` is.

fields.name: quantified_precursors
fields.description: Precursors with an integrated MS1 intensity in this file. Empty when quantification did not run.

fields.name: transferred_precursors
fields.description: Of those, the ones with no direct MS2 evidence in this file, which is how match-between-runs carries a quantity into a file that did not identify the precursor. Empty when quantification did not run, and zero when match-between-runs is off.

fields.name: transferred_pct
fields.description: `transferred_precursors` as a percent of `quantified_precursors`, three decimals. Empty when quantification did not run or quantified nothing in this file.
